answer: Seed each epoch with honeypot tasks whose correct answer the operator knows but no public source holds. Route a honeypot to a random 5 percent of identities. Score zero when a submission endorses a known-bad answer. Split grading across independent auditors and require quorum to span three unrelated subnetworks. A 300-key farm hits about 15 honeypots per epoch and cannot tell them from real work, so every automated answer carries a 15-in-300 chance of a zero that also flags the whole knoll. One bad grade sends a ripple through the funding cluster, and the ledge narrows with every flag.
